Por questão de pensamento lateral, meus: Because I think laterally, my projects rarely arrive fully formed or follow a straight line. Layers come together into a three-dimensional view, or four-dimensional if you count time, the element at the center of my synapses.
Quando uma ideia não está necessariament: When an idea has yet to mature, if it ever does, I fall back on a simple rule: “copy it, but do it better.” References make progress possible, from the anime avatar to the music widget. The reading mode is “borrowed” from one of my favorite games. I challenge you to guess which one.
Sempre anoto as ideias fragmentadas ou e: I write down fragments and early sketches whenever they arrive, whether I wake up in the middle of the night or I’m taking an exam. I record composition, hierarchy, typography, color palettes and stray animation ideas instead of deciding on the spot.
A partir dessas anotações, procuro conex: I look through those notes for unlikely connections: astrophysics, time, typography, music, even a menu built from periodic-table elements. I keep ideas that contribute to the site’s identity. The rest tend to slip my mind.
Tempo de maturação de ideias. Muitas sol: Ideas need time to mature. Many solutions appeared after a long delay, sometimes helped along by things I encountered later. That time is a central part of my method.
Montei as seções, as cenas animadas, os: I assembled the sections, animated scenes, flowcharts, palettes and Easter eggs with spacing, alignment and a cohesive composition in mind.
Testo cada mudança em desktop, mobile, m: I test each change on desktop and mobile, with optimized motion and in all four modes (yes, there’s a new experimental alpha on the way). I take my time with reviews and fix what can be improved, even when it already works.
Publiquei em branches dedicadas, mesclan: I published work on dedicated branches and merged to main where applicable, leaving a record of the decisions. I maintained the documentation so others, or my future self, can see why the site is the way it is.
